snippet.title: Astral Ascent - Expedition33: For those who come after Update
snippet.description:
It’s time to head back to Astral Ascent for a new collaboration with Clair Obscur: Expedition 33!

Both the main cast and iconic bosses like Mimes and Pétank are joining our platformer roguelite. This free update includes 6 new summons, 3 bosses, 2 music tracks and 3 different rooms. And yes, you can hug Esquie…of course you can!

The update is available for FREE on Steam, Humble, Epic Games Store, GOG, PS4/PS5 and Switch 1.
